===========================================================================
- Commands (Thanks! bslenul custom child script; swingflip|compcom mini classics port!)
- --load-base-WAD to choose which base Wad to have as trigger file**
- --custom-file to select one or multiple custom .wad/.pk3 (separated by a comma if multiple, without space!).**
- --no-brutal to disable Brutal Doom mod, because it can conflict with some mods and have unwanted effects.**
- --no-IDKFA-OST to disable Custom OST**
- IE: /bin/sh /var/games/CLV-G-ZDOOM/zdoom.sh --custom-file Castlevania.ipk3 --no-brutal --no-IDKFA-OST**
- Additional Custom Files can be added by separating with commas, IE: zelda1.ipk3, zelda2.ipk3, zelda3.ipk3**
